completion.description: Thank you — that's exactly what I needed before our session.

questions.question: What does a normal day look like for {children.firstName}?
questions.hint: Here are the few things I'd love to know before our session — nothing long, just type whenever you have a minute. Roughly wake / naps / meals / bed.

questions.question: Who's with {children.firstName} most of the day, and what does a usual stretch with {helpers.firstName} look like?
Where does {children.firstName} spend play time — floor, bouncer, cot, someone's lap? And how long on the floor?
Toys and objects — does someone usually hand them over, or does {children.firstName} reach?
Milk and solids going ok? Anything {children.firstName} refuses?
{helpers.firstName} — how long with you, what languages, and open to trying new things?
If one thing felt different after our session, what would you most want it to be?
